name: bug-enrichment-pass
description: Canonical PASS scenario: three well-enriched bug reports (TestScribe-style outputs) satisfying every blocking and non-blocking check.

criteria.name: correctness
criteria.description: Severity and reproduction steps match the defect actually described in the raw report.

criteria.name: completeness
criteria.description: Title, severity, and reproduction steps are all populated with usable content.

criteria.name: clarity
criteria.description: Reproduction steps are unambiguous and follow Given/When/Then form.

cases.input: Raw bug report: The infusion pump alarm doesn't sound when the IV line is blocked.
Raw bug report: Login button does nothing on Firefox after a password reset.
Raw bug report: Search results duplicate every third entry when paginating.
